hooks.name: Raw Pointer Safety Review
hooks.description: After saving Core/ code, review raw-pointer use against swift-memory-safety and darwin-c-interop steering.

action.prompt: A file under GatekeepersWard/Core/ was just saved. Review it against .kiro/steering/swift-memory-safety.md and .kiro/steering/darwin-c-interop.md: confirm every UnsafeRawBufferPointer / withUnsafeBytes / CChar buffer access is bounds-checked, no pointer escapes its closure, Unmanaged retain/release is balanced, sysctl size and errno results are checked, and KERN_PROCARGS2 parsing cannot read past the buffer. Fix any violation and make sure the property-based tests in GatekeepersWardTests/Core still cover the changed behavior.
